candidate: One selected full-T signature per physical bank; accumulate its members locally and release one contribution at the final member's original return slot. Other sources follow direct FTP.
scope: Already-inspected ep34 sample0 stage0 and stage3 block0 FC2 complete captured T/P/C domain; not a new workload or independent-frame validation
bank_rule: source channel modulo 8, matching the current m803 channel split contract
selection: Use only the first min(256, floor(P/4)) spatial positions for calibration. For each bank choose exactly one signature with popcount>=2 maximizing sum_p max(member_count-1,0)*(popcount(signature)-1). Tie: lower unsigned signature. Freeze it for every remaining position. No size/partition/pattern sweep.
evaluation: Report calibration separately from remaining positions in the same captured sample. Direct FTP, chosen per-bank mode and unrestricted temporal-signature grouping use identical supports and free first assignment to each nonempty Y[t].
arithmetic: Saved adds per output channel and group with n members and k active timesteps: max(n-1,0)*(k-1), including n-1 local reduction additions and k output contributions. No multiplication by H until explicitly named.
reads: All nonzero full-T source coefficients are still read once, same as direct FTP. Request beats and final cycle counts are not measured; zero-contribution retirement after weight join is a required protocol condition.
metadata: Charge 8 counters of ceil(log2(C/8+1)) bits per spatial position for the declared uncompressed count layout, plus eight 10-bit selected patterns per layer and eight live partial vectors at the active output-tile width. Build ports, alignment and widened operand timing remain unmodeled.
diagnostic: For a fixed set of boundary/calibration/evaluation positions, execute the actual last-member protocol using signed, nonunit-theta rational numerator coefficients and compare every T output to dense source multiplication. Small deterministic synthetic edge cases also checked.
stop: Do not implement production RTL from arithmetic alone. Report whether useful arithmetic remains with bank-local constraints; any throughput, state, timing or novelty promotion requires a separate complete-path comparison.
